transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?

Well, thank you for seeing me, Doctor. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. Um... my husband actually wanted me to come in. I really don't want to sound like a complainer, or like I'm being a difficult person, but... well, for nearly two years now, I've just been so sure that our contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. 

They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and it's just been so stressful. My husband, he tries to show me all these receipts to calm me down, and the workers give so many excuses, but... I just know what's happening. I hope that doesn't sound too silly or unreasonable to you? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it right.
Have you ever heard people talking or whispering about you when no one was actually there?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that. I mean, I hear them talking when they're actually in my house, or out on the street, but not... not out of thin air, if that makes sense? I don't want you to think I'm imagining things or hearing voices like a crazy person. I'm very level-headed, I promise. It's just... I just notice what they're doing with the house. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I hope I answered that right.
Aside from the stress about the house, how has your mood been—have you felt persistently down, sad, or lost interest in your usual activities?

Oh, no, no. I mean... I really try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I'd hate for you to think I'm just sitting around moping all day. I haven't been depressed or anything like that. 

I still enjoy my little routines. I love my gardening, and keeping the house nice—well, the parts they haven't ruined, anyway. I'm actually a very cheerful person normally. I really hope I'm not coming across as a miserable complainer today. It's truly just the stress of what they're doing to the house that gets me worked up, but otherwise I'm quite content. Does that answer your question okay?
Before this trouble with the contractors began two years ago, did you generally find it easy to trust friends, colleagues, and other people in your life?

Oh, goodness, yes. I've always been a very trusting person. I... well, I like to think it's a good quality to have, don't you? Before all this mess started, I got along wonderfully with everyone—my friends, the other neighbors, people I'd chat with at the store. 

I've never been the sort of person who is naturally suspicious or difficult, I promise you that. I really always try to see the best in people. I think that's why this whole situation with the house has been so hard for me to wrap my head around, because it's just not in my nature to assume people are doing bad things. But yes, to answer your question, I've always found it very easy to trust people. I hope that's what you were looking for?
